# AnyStudio

> AnyStudio turns a single phone photo of a product into the images, words and
> short video a seller needs to post it — on WhatsApp, with no app to install,
> and on the web. Individuals use the same tool for flyers and posters.

AnyStudio is an AI content studio for people who sell things. The input is one
ordinary photo — a bottle on a kitchen table, a bag on a bed. The output is a
contact sheet: the same product on studio backdrops, a written product
description, captions sized for each channel, and a short vertical reel. The
product itself is never redrawn; only what surrounds it changes.

## How it works

1. Send the photo to AnyStudio on WhatsApp (+1 775 303 2588) or drop it into the web app.
2. Say the product name and the price in one line.
3. Branded images, a description, captions and a reel come back in the same thread.
4. Post straight to Instagram, TikTok or WhatsApp Status, or download the files.

## Who it is for

- **Individuals** — event flyers, posters, birthday and party graphics from a photo.
- **Sellers and small businesses** — storefront images, product descriptions, reels, brand kits.
- **Organizations and marketplaces** — subscribe on behalf of the merchants on your platform; projects, API keys, seats with roles, and an audit log.

## Pricing

Credits, not per-seat. An image costs 10 credits; a reel costs 120.

- **Starter** — free, three generations total, no card required.
- **Creator** — $9/month, 600 credits (~60 images or 5 reels).
- **Business** — $29/month, 2,400 credits (~240 images or 20 reels).
- **Organization** — $199/month, 12,000 credits, seats, projects and API access.

Prices are set per market rather than converted at the day's exchange rate, so
the amount does not move month to month. Nigerian pricing is in naira via
Flutterwave; international pricing is in USD and GBP via Paddle.

## Facts worth quoting accurately

- Works entirely inside WhatsApp — there is nothing to install.
- The product in the photo is preserved; if a generation alters it, the credit is refunded.
- Running out of credits never removes your library, brand kits or connected accounts.
- Brand kits are shared across a workspace on Business; Organization adds roles and audit logs.
